CAN THE MAZDA3 MAKE DRIVING BETTER?
In the newly restyled 2017 Mazda3, art meets engineering. But to what end? Does incessantly improving every detail matter to you?
Are you drawn to our determination to create beauty through our KODO: “Soul of Motion” design? Or our focused desire to create
a car that’s light, strong and technologically advanced? The truth is, Mazda knows that all of it matters. Because Driving Matters.
From the drawing board to the passing lane, driving enjoyment is our final measure of success. Even how you feel at the end of a
long drive is an indication of a great-driving car. If you like driving, you may find yourself loving the Mazda3.

IS IT POSSIBLE TO ENGINEER
AN EMOTION?
The Mazda3 is a testament to obsessive engineering. Down to the smallest
detail. To achieve a greater level of precision and artistry, Mazda engineers
sculpt every design in hard clay rather than rely solely on computer-aided
design. By using special tools crafted by the artists themselves, Mazda is
able to produce a design so precise that it measures within a fraction of a
millimeter of the engineers’ original vision. Of course, the original vision
was not to build to a set of mathematical equations. It was to create a
sense of motion in every shape and detail. It’s a level of craftsmanship that
might seem extreme, but we’re Mazda, and we won’t build anything less.
ENLIGHTENED DESIGN
Working in concert with the craftsmanship and artistry of clay modeling,
our engineers used computer-aided drafting models to project simulated
reflections on the surface of the Mazda3. Based on these reflections, our
engineers subtly adjusted the lines and curves of the Mazda3’s exterior
design to achieve the most symmetrical and visually pleasing design.

A CLEAR VISION
OF THE ROAD AHEAD.
The Mazda3’s restructured KODO-design headlamps are not only striking,
but provide a sharper vision of the road. Available LED headlights
incorporate a dynamic light-guiding ring and feature LED Daytime Running
Lights for more effective illumination. In Grand Touring models with the
Premium Package, an Adaptive Front-lighting System adjusts the angle of
the vehicle’s headlights according to the steering angle and vehicle speed,
while available High Beam Control also improves your view. This innovative
system works automatically to maximize your opportunity to use your high
beams and, on the flip side, dim your lights when it detects approaching
vehicles or vehicles in front of you in your lane. Beautifully designed and
technologically advanced, there’s no better way to illuminate your journey.
FREE-FLOWING
The Mazda3 Grand Touring with i-ELOOP Package is equipped with an
Active Grille Shutter System that temporarily closes the grille shutters
to limit excess airflow to the engine bay, improving aerodynamics.

MORE INNOVATION.
MORE DRIVING EXHILARATION.
Exhilaration has always run in the Mazda3 family. And the 2017 Mazda3
continues this legacy. Always pushing the limits, the Mazda3’s already
excellent performance and handling amplifies the exhilaration with a precisely
tuned 4-wheel independent suspension system and your choice of spirited
2.0-liter or 2.5-liter SKYACTIV®-G gasoline engines, with the 2.5-liter offering
184 horsepower. Also helping to make your drive smooth and enjoyable is
SKYACTIV-VEHICLE DYNAMICS with G-Vectoring Control, a breakthrough
technology that helps control the vehicle’s weight and momentum to provide
a more precise and less-fatiguing drive. The Mazda3 proves that our engineers
will go to any length to improve your driving experience.
JINBA ITTAI
To achieve “oneness” between a vehicle and its driver, Mazda engineers were inspired
by the concept of jinba ittai, or “horse and rider as one.” When a vehicle becomes an
extension of the driver, only then is perfect harmony achieved. And everything in the
Mazda3, from the throttle response and driver-centered cockpit to the agile steering,
delivers this principle of jinba ittai. Because Driving Matters.

WHY MAZDA3 DRIVERS
NEVER FEEL LIKE THEY’RE
STUCK IN TRAFFIC.
For our Mazda engineers, creating a car that’s sporty, practical and exhilarating
to drive simply wasn’t enough. They wanted to enliven the driving experience
from the moment you open the door. To create this new level of connectedness,
the center gauge lights up and pulsates like a heartbeat when you enter the
cabin. And when you use the push button to start the ignition, the side gauges
also illuminate, while—when equipped—the newly restyled Active Driving
Display rises to greet you. Sharper quality, increased resolution and even more
pertinent information are directly in your field of vision. Even the Mazda3
cockpit is built to keep you connected. Designed around a theoretical vanishing
point that’s forward-focused, it helps keep your attention on the road ahead.
Just another reason why everything about the Mazda3 is exciting, alive—
and completely connected.
DASH YOUR INHIBITIONS
The available full-color Active Driving Display is strategically positioned directly in the
driver’s field of vision. By projecting critical driving information directly in front of you,
right within your line of sight, this innovative display helps you take your mind off of
distractions and your eyes focused toward one place—the road ahead.

As part of the Grand Touring Premium Package, paddle shifters
on the steering wheel allow you to upshift and downshift the
SKYACTIV®-Drive 6-speed automatic transmission without
taking your hands off the wheel. Or your eyes off the road.

THE LITTLE THINGS WILL
ALWAYS MATTER TO US.
Cabin enhancements made to the Mazda3 offer a new level of distinction
nonexistent in other affordable compact cars. Never satisfied with the
status quo, we considered every interior detail for quality and comfort.
From improvements in accessibility to each control, to new high-end
appointments and finishes—including an elegant center console design
and available heated steering wheel—the evolved cockpit delivers
a relaxed and enjoyable drive, no matter how far the journey.
THE HOLE TRUTH
By making the seat perforations moderately large and the distances between them
small, our engineers created upholstery that’s not only soft and breathable, but also
absorbs road noise for an enhanced audio listening environment.
PERFECT FIT
The Mazda3’s sport seats are contoured to mold perfectly to the body, giving you
and your passengers a more comfortable and connected ride, no matter how long
the commute. Adding to the Mazda3’s high-end appeal are its available dual-stitched
leather and leatherette seats that are as carefully crafted as they are beautiful.

STORAGE FLEXIBILITY THAT GIVES YOU ROOM TO ROAM.
With the Mazda3, you can enjoy all the conveniences of a compact car without ever compromising cargo space. With both rear seatbacks
folded down, Mazda3 5-Door models offer up to a generous 47.1 cubic feet of storage space. And when you have more passengers than gear,
the Mazda3 offers plenty of versatility. Its 60/40 split fold-down rear seatbacks allow you to either fold down both sections for maximum
storage, or keep one section up, leaving room for a passenger or child safety seat.

IN TUNE WITH YOU IN EVERY SENSE. C
We believe a connected driving experience should even include your sense of hearing. That’s why for the Mazda3,
we opted for nothing less than the latest generation Bose® Centerpoint® 2 Surround Sound System.
This available system with 9 speakers enables listeners to enjoy a surround sound experience from nearly any stereo source. A A
It has been specifically engineered to meet the unique demands of reproducing surround sound for the Mazda3’s interior dimensions.
And unlike conventional synthesized surround sound systems that compare left and right channel information to create a virtual
surround experience, Centerpoint® 2 technology uses frequency content in addition to stereo information to create a more lifelike
surround experience, while AudioPilot® 2 technology compensates for ambient noise within the cabin.
